methodHandling.otherMethods: Any method other than POST -> 405 {"error":"Method not allowed"}, checked BEFORE auth (so an unauthenticated GET gets 405, not 401). No Allow header.

auth.notes: After the method check, before body parse.

request.parse: body = await req.json() (slide-transcript.ts:10-15). Malformed JSON -> 500 'Internal error'. JSON null -> body?.deckId falsy -> 400.

fields.name: slideNumber
fields.bounds: any number (no integer/positivity check; NaN impossible from JSON)

fields.name: messages
fields.validation: !Array.isArray -> 400. Elements not validated; a null element -> TypeError reading .role -> 500. Content string kept; content array: text blocks kept verbatim, other blocks replaced by {type, data:'[attachment]', media_type: b.media_type ?? null}; any other content passed as-is.

fields.name: refineCount
fields.bounds: not validated (any JSON value except null/undefined is stored)

request.unknownFields: Ignored; unknown keys inside each message are dropped (only role/content kept).

errors.when: malformed JSON, null message element, non-UUID deckId, ownsDeck DB error

sideEffects: Upsert slide_edit_transcripts {user_id, deck_id, slide_number, messages (sanitized), refine_count, updated_at} on conflict (deck_id, slide_number) — awaited, but errors only logged (_shared/db.ts:417-436)
quirks: Only route in this group with an explicit method check, and it precedes auth.
Upsert key is (deck_id, slide_number): the whole thread is replaced each call.
DB errors never surface: always {ok:true} once validation/ownership pass.
Base64 attachment payloads are stripped to '[attachment]' before storage.
beforeAnyState: Creates the row on first call; no prior state needed beyond deck ownership.

tests.asserts: No test file exists for slide-transcript (netlify/functions/_tests has none).

planSection65: Row '{deckId, slideNumber, messages[], refineCount?} → {ok:true}' — accurate; add 405 'Method not allowed' before auth.
